nodes.title: Customers order in-stock items and are kept informed
nodes.body: Orders are only accepted for reservable stock, and customers and merchandisers receive timely notifications.

success_criteria: No order is accepted without a stock reservation
Every placed order produces a confirmation email

nodes.title: Ordering
nodes.body: Place orders against reserved stock.

nodes.title: Notifications
nodes.body: Customer and merchandising notifications.

nodes.title: Place an order
nodes.body: A customer places an order for in-stock items. The order service reserves stock through the inventory API before accepting the order and shows the order total.

acceptance_criteria: An order is accepted only after a successful reservation
The order total is shown with two decimal places

nodes.title: Reserve stock atomically
nodes.body: Stock is reserved atomically per SKU; a reservation expires after 15 minutes if the order is not confirmed.

acceptance_criteria: Two concurrent reservations never oversell a SKU

nodes.title: Send order confirmation email
nodes.body: After an order is placed, the customer receives a confirmation email rendered from the email template, including the order total.

acceptance_criteria: An email is sent for every OrderPlaced event
The email shows the order total

nodes.title: Low-stock alert
nodes.body: Merchandising is alerted when on-hand stock of a SKU falls below 10 units. Alerts are produced from the reservation events emitted by CMP-INVENTORY.

acceptance_criteria: An alert is raised when on-hand stock drops below 10 units
At most one alert per SKU per day

nodes.title: Inventory reservation API
nodes.body: reserve(sku, qty) returns {reservation_id, expires_at}; expires_at is an absolute UTC ISO-8601 timestamp. Reservations are atomic.

nodes.title: OrderPlaced event schema
nodes.body: OrderPlaced {order_id, customer_email, total, currency} is published once per accepted order.

nodes.title: Confirmation email template
nodes.body: Template variables: order_id, total, currency.

nodes.title: Money formatting
nodes.body: Amounts are decimal strings with exactly two places, rounded half-to-even (banker's rounding).

nodes.title: Order service
nodes.body: Accepts orders, calls the inventory reservation API and publishes OrderPlaced events.

nodes.title: Inventory service
nodes.body: Owns stock levels and reservations; emits reservation events.

nodes.title: Notification service
nodes.body: Sends confirmation emails and low-stock alerts.

nodes.title: Money library
nodes.body: Shared money arithmetic and formatting used by services that display amounts.

nodes.title: Order placement end-to-end
nodes.body: Places an order against a stub inventory and asserts reservation and acceptance.

nodes.title: Concurrent reservation
nodes.body: Concurrent reservations of the last unit; asserts no oversell and expiry.

nodes.title: Confirmation email rendering
nodes.body: Renders the confirmation email from a sample OrderPlaced event.

nodes.title: Low-stock alert
nodes.body: Feeds reservation events and asserts alerting and daily de-duplication.

nodes.title: Money formatting
nodes.body: Rounding and formatting table tests.

nodes.title: What is the low-stock threshold?
nodes.body: Merchandising confirmed a fixed threshold of 10 units.
